    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The non-background horizontal bar is the source row. Each colored
    # marker rises by the horizontal distance to the next marker or edge.
    candidates = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    if len(candidates) != 1:
        return out
    r = candidates[0]
    row = grid[r]
    marks = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 1)]
    for i, c in enumerate(marks):
        end = marks[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(marks) else len(row) - 1
        height = end - c
        for step in range(1, min(height, r + 1)):
            out[r - step][c] = 1
        if height <= r:
            out[r - height][c] = row[c]
        else:
            out[0][c] = row[c]
    return out
